Spells:
Accelerate Poison (D2 Tran): Causes a choice of poison affecting touched to take effect immediately or to inflict damage twice as often for half its normal duration (save Fortitude DC 12 negates)
Alter Winds (D1 Tran): Increases or decreases strong natural winds 1 step in a 10' radius around a touched point (save Will DC 11 negates) for 10 hr
Aqueous Orb (D3 Conj): R200' Creates a 10' diameter sphere of water that can be moved 30' per rd and rolled over 10' obstacles for 10 rd; it douses normal fires, acts as Dispel Magic on Large or smaller magical fires, inflicts 2d6 HP nonlethal (save Reflex DC 13 negates), and engulfs 1 Large, 4 Medium, or 16 Small creatures who fail their saves (save Reflex DC 13 negates), inflicting an additional 2d6 HP nonlethal each rd and potential drowning
Aspect Of The Bear (D2 Tran): Gives self a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor, +2 CMB, and the ability to perform Bull Rush, Grapple, and Overrun without provoking AOO, for 10 min
Aspect Of The Falcon (D1 Tran): Gives self +3 Perception, +1 ranged attacks, and a crit of x3@19 with bows and crossbows, for 10 min
Aspect Of The Stag (D4 Tran): Gives self a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class vs. AOO, +20 Speed, movement at full Speed in undergrowth, and an immediate attack with antlers after a successful foe AOO (+14 attack inflicts 1d8-2 HP piercing x2@19), for 10 min
Aspect Of The Wolf (D5 Tran): Gives self +4 Strength and Dexterity, the Scent feature, +2 Trip attack, and swift Trip without provoking AOO, for 10 min
Ball Lightning (D4 Evoc): R200' Creates 2 5' spheres that fly 20' per rd for 10 rd, stopping for 1 rd to inflict 3d6 HP electricity on creatures they encounter (save Reflex DC 14 negates; creatures in metal armor have a -4 penalty on the save)
Blessing Of Courage and Life (C2 Conj): R50' Gives the living target +2 saves vs. fear and death (save Will DC 12 negates) for 10 min; it can end the spell early to regain 1d8+10 hit points
Blessing Of Fervor (C4 Tran): R50' Gives 10 targets in a 15' radius a choice each rd (save Fortitude DC 14 negates) for 10 rd: +30 Speed; standing as a swift action without provoking AOO; an extra attack as part of a full-attack action; +2 attacks, a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class, and +2 Reflex saves; free use of Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell on a spell of up to 2nd level
Blessing Of The Salamander (D5 Tran): Gives touched fast healing 5, fire resistance 20, and +2 CMD (save Fortitude DC 15 negates) for 10 rd
Bloody Claws (D4 Necr): Enhances natural slashing or piercing attacks by the touched living creature (save Fortitude DC 14 negates) to inflict bleed damage equal to the lesser of 5 HP or the maximum damage possible from the attack itself for 10 min
Bristle (D1 Tran): Each rd for 10 min, allows touched to reduce its natural armor bonus to Armor Class by up to 3 for an equal damage bonus on natural attacks (save Fortitude DC 11 negates)
Burning Gaze (D2 Evoc): Allows self to use a standard action each rd for 10 rd to inflict 1d6 HP fire on a target within 30' (save Fortitude DC 12 negates); targets who fail their saves catch on fire, suffering an additional 1d6 HP fire each rd (save Reflex DC 12 ends)
Call Animal (D1 Ench): Causes the nearest wild animal of a chosen type (CR 10 maximum) to move toward self for 10 hr
Clashing Rocks (D9 Conj): R800' Creates two Colossal rocks that slam together in a ranged touch attack that inflicts 20d6 HP bludgeoning, knocked prone, and buried in rubble (save Reflex DC 19 negates buried); a missed target and other creatures in the path of the rocks suffer 10d6 HP bludgeoning and knocked prone (save Reflex DC 19 inflicts half HP only)
Cleanse (C5 Evoc): Self regains 4d8+10 hit points, recovers from ability damage, blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, diseased, exhausted, fatigued, nauseated, poisoned, and sickened, and breaks one enchantment
Cloak Of Shade (D1 Abju): Allows 10 touched to treat heat from sunlight as 1 level less severe and to reduce penalties from sunlight by 1 (save Will DC 11 negates) for 10 hr
Cloak Of Winds (D3 Abju): R50' Creates winds that protect the living target (save Fortitude DC 13 negates) for 10 min: foes suffer -4 ranged attacks, and Tiny foes cannot touch the target, are pushed away 50', and suffer 3d6 HP nonlethal, plus 1d6 HP if they strike a solid object (save Fortitude DC 13 negates)
Cup Of Dust (D3 Tran): R50' Inflicts unquenchable thirst that leads to dehydration (save Fortitude DC 13 negates) for 10 dy
Detect Aberration (D1 Divi): 800' cone reveals the presence and condition of a chosen kind of aberration for concentration up to 100 min; can change the chosen kind each rd
Dispel Magic (Dispelling Touch3 Abju): R200' Allows a successful caster level check vs. a DC of 11 + caster level to cancel an ongoing targeted spell, suppress a magic item for 1d4 rd, or disrupt a foe's spell casting
Eagle Eye (D2 Divi): Allows self to view from a point up to 800' overhead for 10 min
Expeditious Excavation (D1 Tran): R50' Moves a 5' cube of dirt; creatures on top fall into the resulting pit (save Reflex DC 11 negates)
Feast Of Ashes (D2 Tran): R50' Inflicts insatiable hunger that leads to starvation (save Fortitude DC 12 negates), and eating causes 1 rd nausea (save Fortitude DC 12 negates), for 20 dy
Fire Snake (D5 Evoc): 10 contiguous 5' squares within 60', at least one of which must be adjacent to self, inflict 10d6 HP fire (save Reflex DC 15 half)
Geyser (D4 Conj): R800' 5' sq inflicts 3d6 HP fire and up to 5d6 falling (save Reflex DC 14 half fire only), and the surrounding 25' radius inflicts 1d6 HP fire, for concentration + 1 rd
Glide (D2 Tran): Slows self fall to 60' per rd, while allowing horizontal movement of 300' per rd, for 10 min
Grace (C2 Abju): Allows self to move without provoking AOO until the end of the turn
Grove Of Respite (D4 Conj): R50' Creates a 20' radius grove that reports intruders and provides water and fruit that feeds 8 and restores 1 hit point for 20 hr
Guiding Star (C3 Divi): Reveals the direction and distance to the casting location for 10 days
Hide Campsite (D3 Illu): R50' 20' cube conceals camping activity (save Will DC 13 upon interaction negates) for 20 hr
Hydraulic Push (D1 Evoc): R50' Creates a blast of water that performs a +13 Bull Rush on the target and extinguishes normal fires up to 5'x5'
Hydraulic Torrent (D3 Evoc): Creates a 60' line of water that performs a +13 Bull Rush on creatures, extinguishes normal fires, and makes a +13 check to break immovable objects
Instant Armor (C2 Conj): Gives self force armor equivalent to half-plate or magical lesser armor for 10 min
Life Bubble (C5 Abju): Allows 10 touched to breathe freely, remain comfortable between -40F and 150F, and ignore pressure effects (save Will DC 15 negates), dividing 20 hr of the effects among them
Lily Pad Stride (D3 Tran): R800' Allows self to walk across water, and others of Medium size or smaller to follow at half Speed with successful DC 10 Acrobatics checks each rd (moving at full Speed inflicts -5 on the checks), for 100 min
Lockjaw (D2 Tran): Gives touched the ability to make a +4 grapple attempt without provoking an AOO after a successful attack with a chosen natural weapon (save Fortitude DC 12 negates) for 10 rd
Moonstruck (D4 Ench): R200' Target suffers dazed for 1 rd while growing claws and fangs, then gains a bite attack, two claw attacks, and Confusion (randomly: 25% act normally; 25% babble; 25% inflict 1d8 + strength modifier to self; 25% attack the nearest creature) and Rage (+2 Strength; +2 Constitution; +1 Will; -2 Armor Class) effects for 8 rd, then suffers dazed for 1 rd while its hands and teeth return to normal (save Will DC 14 negates)
Nap Stack (C3 Necr): For 8 hr, a 30' emanation gives the benefits of 8 hr sleep for each 2 hr of uninterrupted sleep (save Will DC 13 negates); a creature can benefit from Nap Stack no more than once per week
Natural Rhythm (D2 Tran): Gives touched a +1 cumulative damage bonus vs. each foe each time it hits that foe with a natural attack (+5 maximum, and a miss resets the bonus vs. all foes to 0) (save Will DC 12 negates) for 10 rd
Nature's Exile (D3 Tran): Inflicts on touched permanent hostility from natural animals and -10 Survival (save Will DC 13 negates); any animal companion instead suffers -2 attacks, skill checks, and saves
Pillar Of Life (C5 Conj): R200' Creates a 5' square of positive energy that restores 2d8+10 hit points on first contact for 10 rd; undead instead suffer 10d6 HP, or 10d8 HP if light-sensitive
Pox Pustules (D2 Necr): R50' Inflicts sickened and -4 Dexterity (save Fortitude DC 12 negates; spending a move action scratching negates sickened for 1 rd) for 10 min
Rampart (D7 Conj): R200' Creates a 50' wall or a 13' radius ring of packed earth and stone, 10' high and 5' thick; each 5' section has hardness 0 and 180 hit points and requires a DC 20 Climb check to climb over and a DC 60 Strength check to break
Rest Eternal (D5 Necr): Curses the touched corpse to require a DC 21 caster check to communicate, resurrect, or animate
River Of Wind (D4 Evoc): 5'x120' line inflicts 4d6 HP nonlethal and knocked prone initially (save Fortitude DC 14 half HP only), then 2d6 HP nonlethal, pushed 20', and knocked prone (save Fortitude DC 14 1d6 HP only) for 9 rd
Sacred Bond (C3 Conj): Allows self and touched to cast touch healing spells on each other at R50' (save Will DC 13 negates) for 100 min
Scent Trail (D2 Tran): R50' 10 designated creatures in a 15' radius gain +20 Survival to follow the target's trail (save Fortitude DC 12 negates) and the ability to understand scent messages left along it with a DC 20 Survival check, with a -1 penalty for each word or emotion in the message, for 10 hr
Seamantle (D8 Conj): 30' high water column around self inflicts DC 20 + spell level caster level checks on fire spells to take effect, suppresses the flaming and flaming burst properties of weapons (save Fortitude DC 18 negates) for 1d4 rd, and gives self a +8 cover bonus to Armor Class, +4 Reflex, a 30' slam attack that inflicts 1d4 HP bludgeoning, and a standard action touch that extinguishes fires for 10 min
Shifting Sand (D3 Tran): R200' 10' radius earth or sand creates difficult terrain, inflicts -10 Acrobatics, and entangles (save Reflex DC 13 negates; moving while entangled requires another save that inflicts knocked prone on failure) for 10 rd; can use a move action each rd to move the effect 10'
Sirocco (D6 Evoc): R200' 60' high, 20' radius cylinder inflicts 4d6+10 HP fire, fatigued, and knocked prone (save Fortitude DC 16 half HP and fatigued only; creatures with the water subtype suffer a -4 penalty on the save and double HP on failure) and inflicts falling damage on flying creatures (save Fly DC 15 negates) for 10 rd
Slipstream (D2 Conj): Creates a wave that gives touched +10 Speed on flat ground, +20 Speed when moving downhill, and a +20 swim Speed, (save Reflex DC 12 negates) for 100 min
Snake Staff (C5 Tran): R200' Transforms sticks in 15' radius into up to 10 telepathically controlled snakes (save Will DC 15 negates) for 10 rd; a venomous snake counts as 1 snake, a constrictor as 2, an advanced snake as +1, and a giant snake as +2
Spiritual Ally (C4 Evoc): R200' Creates a force being that can be moved 30' as a swift action, counts as an ally for the purpose of flanking, and makes +14/+9/+4 attacks each rd that inflict 1d10+3 HP, for 10 rd; the first attack on a target is subject to SR, and failure to overcome it ends the spell
Stone Call (D2 Conj): R200' 40' radius inflicts 2d6 HP bludgeoning for 1 rd, then difficult terrain for 9 rd
Stormbolts (C8 Evoc): Targets within 30' suffer 10d8 HP electricity and stunned for 1 rd (save Fortitude DC 18 half HP only)
Strong Jaw (D4 Tran): Causes the touched natural weapon to inflict damage as a creature 2 sizes larger (save Fortitude DC 14 negates) for 10 min
Swarm Skin (D6 Tran): Transforms self flesh into controlled swarms until they are destroyed or ordered to return to bones; can divide 10 levels among swarms of spiders (costs 2), rats (costs 4), crabs or wasps (cost 6 each), centipedes or leeches (cost 8 each), and army ants (cost 10)
Threefold Aspect (D5 Tran): Allows self to transform freely between young adult (gives +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and -2 Wisdom), adult (gives +2 Wisdom, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Dexterity), and elderly (gives +4 Wisdom, +4 Intelligence, -2 Strength, and -2 Dexterity) for 24 hr
True Form (D4 Abju): R200' Removes polymorph effects from 3 targets in a 15' radius (save Will DC 14 negates for the polymorph ability, and a second, full-rd save during the duration after a failure ends) for 10 rd; reversing a polymorph spell requires a DC 11 + effect level caster level check (+15 maximum)
Tsunami (D9 Conj): R800' 10'x10'x20' wave moves 30' each rd (60' over water), inflicts 8d6 HP bludgeoning (save Fortitude DC 19 half), and makes +21 combat maneuvers to knock down and sweep away creatures, inflicting 6d6 HP on them each rd (successful combat maneuver or Swim check ends), for 5 rd
Veil (Masters Illusion6 Illu): R800' Makes creatures in a 15' radius appear to be different creatures (save Will DC 19 negates for targets; save Will upon interaction disbelieves for others) for concentration + 10 hr
Vortex (D7 Evoc): R800' Creates in a body of liquid a 15' radius, 50' deep whirlpool that inflicts 3d6 HP bludgeoning on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex DC 17 negates), then 1d8 HP bludgeoning each rd on Medium and smaller creatures who fail their initial save (save Reflex DC 17 negates) for 9 rd or until deliberately ejected; boats up to 30' long suffer 6d6 HP and are pulled into the current (a successful DC 25 Profession (Sailor) check reduces the damage by half and leaves the boat free of the current), and longer boats suffer half HP only
Wall Of Lava (D8 Conj): R200' Creates 10 contiguous 5'x5'x2" wall sections, each with hardness 4 and 90 hit points, that inflict 2d4 HP fire to creatures within 10' and 1d4 HP fire to those within 20' for 10 rd; weapon strikes on the wall inflict 2d6 HP fire to the weapon, and passage through requires a DC 25 Strength check and inflicts 20d6 HP fire; allows a R60' ranged touch attack once per rd as a move action that inflicts 10d6 HP fire but destroys 1d4 wall sections; all damage from the wall continues to inflict half HP for 1d3 rd after exposure ends
Weapon Of Awe (C2 Tran): Enchants the touched weapon or unarmed strike (save Will DC 12 negates) for 10 min, giving it a +2 sacred bonus to damage and critical hits that inflict shaken for 1 rd
Winds Of Vengeance (C9 Evoc): Gives self a 60' fly Speed with perfect maneuverability, breathable air, and immunity to wind, gas, and ranged weapons; inflicts on melee attackers 5d8 HP bludgeoning and knocked prone, or blown away if flying (save Fortitude DC 19 half HP only; Huge flying creatures are checked instead), for 10 min
World Wave (D9 Tran): Allows self and 10 designated creatures to ride a 20'x100' section of natural terrain that forms a 30' wave for 10 rd or a 5' swell for 10 hr, moves 160' per rd, and inflicts 6d6 HP (wave) or 1d6 HP (swell) bludgeoning to non-natural objects in its path; constructs and undead suffer double damage
Wrathful Mantle (C3 Evoc): Gives touched a +2 resistance bonus to saves (save Will DC 13 negates) for 10 min; the target can dismiss the spell to inflict 2d8 HP force on all creatures within 5'
Magic Notes:
Greater Elemental Focus (Acid): Increased Elemental Focus (Acid) effects
Aligned Spells: Cannot cast spells with an alignment opposed to own or deity's alignment
Arcane Beacon: 15' radius gives arcane casters choice of +1 caster level or DC for 1 rd 3/dy
Craft Wand: Can create wands for known spells of up to 4th level
Dispelling Touch: Touch invokes Dispel Magic effects once per day
Elemental Focus (Acid): +2 save DC on spells that inflict acid damage
Enlarge Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to double its range
Master's Illusion: 30' emanation invokes Veil effects (save Will DC 15 disbelieve) for 10 rd per day
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
Spontaneous Casting (Druid): Can cast Summon Nature's Ally spells in place of prepared spells
Widen Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to double its area of affect
Wild Shape: Can change into a diminutive to huge animal, a small to large plant, or a small to large elemental for 10 hr 4 times per day
Notes
Validation Warnings: Deception Subdomain: Implies bluff skill, disguise skill or stealth skill
